basic_details.job_title: DCHS Kadapa Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 11 Theatre Assistant and GDA/MNO/FNO Posts
basic_details.organization_name: District Coordinator of Hospital Services Kadapa (DCHS Kadapa)
basic_details.short_information: District Coordinator of Hospital Services Kadapa (DCHS Kadapa) Theatre Assistant and GDA/MNO/FNO Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of District Coordinator of Hospital Services Kadapa (DCHS Kadapa). A total of 11 vacancies have been announced through the DCHS Kadapa Theatre Assistant and GDA/MNO/FNO Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 42 years. Age Relaxation: SC/ST/BC/EWS: 47 years, Physically Handicapped: 52 years as on 01-07-2026.

qualification.education_qualification: SSC/10th or equivalent from a recognized Board
qualification.details: Theatre Assistant: Must have passed SSC/10th or its equivalent. GDA/MNO/FNO: Must have passed SSC/10th Class or its equivalent from a recognized Board.

selection_process: Merit basis as per rule of reservations 75% Aggregate marks in qualifying examination Up to 15% Weightage for Government/Contract/Outsourcing experience Up to 10 marks for years since passing qualifying examination
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DCHS Kadapa Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://kadapa.ap.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 04-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCHS Kadapa Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://kadapa.ap.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 04-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCHS Kadapa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive applications for the DCHS Kadapa Recruitment 2026 is 04 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC/10th or its equivalent from a recognized Board to be eligible for the Theatre Assistant and GDA/MNO/FNO posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the DCHS Kadapa vacancies?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 42 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/BC/EWS candidates (47 years) and Physically Handicapped candidates (52 years) as of 01-07-2026.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the application fee for DCHS Kadapa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 300/- for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 15,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for DCHS Kadapa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on merit, considering aggregate marks in the qualifying examination, weightage for government/contract experience, and marks for years since passing the examination.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the DCHS Kadapa vacancies?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by post. Download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies for Theatre Assistant and GDA/MNO/FNO posts.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the DCHS Kadapa Recruitment 2026 is for contractual positions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Coordinator of Hospital Services Kadapa, which is https://kadapa.ap.gov.in.
